info.title: PicJP modular API
info.description: Generated from executable Zod contracts and the V1 interface design. Public /api routes are the local Vercel backend; operation-level .invalid servers mark undeployed JEV design/Worker local implementation. Cross-resource authorization, idempotency, ownership, payment facts, binary image validation and refined invariants require runtime enforcement; schemas alone do not prove those properties.

servers.description: Current Vercel application origin; real external services require deployment configuration.

SupabaseBearer.description: Server verifies the access token with Supabase Auth getUser. Cookies alone are not authentication; user_id is never accepted from the browser.

StripeWebhookSignature.name: Stripe-Signature
StripeWebhookSignature.description: Stripe SDK verifies this signature over the exact raw body before parsing. This is a webhook signature, not a reusable API key.

JevHmacSignature.name: X-Service-Signature
JevHmacSignature.description: Hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, POST + newline + /v1/recommend + newline + timestamp + newline + sha256(exact raw body)). X-Service-Timestamp is Unix seconds, clock skew <=60s. TLS required. Read-only scoring still requires rate limiting and request_id replay deduplication.

GoogleOidc.description: Cloud Run IAM authentication; not cloud-verified yet. Token audience is the Cloud Run service URL; grant invoker only to approved Scheduler/dispatcher identities. Separate from end-user Supabase authentication.

SeoConsentCookie.name: picmoko_seo
SeoConsentCookie.description: HttpOnly signed consent session, max 30 minutes. Same-origin Origin header is additionally required. This cookie is not user authentication.

SeoHmac.name: X-Seo-Signature
SeoHmac.description: Hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, exact raw JSON body). Signed Unix timestamp within 300s and one-time nonce. Server-side secret at least 32 characters.

EditRequest.description: Exactly one primary image, first in order; unique image IDs. Tool-specific parameter allowlists and minimum input counts are validated server-side. All inputs must be owned, ready, and unexpired. A matching idempotency key reuses the original snapshot; different content conflicts. These cross-field rules require runtime validation beyond OpenAPI 3.0.

JevRequest.description: DESIGN ONLY. Internal authenticated JPEG thumbnail request. Decoded JPEG <=1 MiB and true dimensions <=768 each; verify byte limits and dimensions at runtime. Candidate metadata comes from the trusted current catalog, never arbitrary user URLs.

JevResponse.description: DESIGN ONLY. Finite ranking scores may be negative or greater than one; they are not probabilities. Caller checks request/catalog/version equality, candidate membership, uniqueness and actual top_k.

PublicRecommendation.description: Model failure degrades to source=fallback with score=null and POPULAR_FALLBACK, or an empty list if no eligible tools. Fallback never claims image understanding.

InternalHealthResponse.description: DESIGN ONLY liveness/readiness response with the V1 protocol version. No model paths, credentials or host metadata.

post.summary: Atomically create queued job and reserve credits
post.description: Optional X-Picjp-Device header is a coarse client viewport observation (mobile/tablet/desktop/unknown), frozen only on first creation; excluded from business idempotency hash. Retired tools reject new jobs with UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY; an existing matching idempotency key still replays its frozen task. GENERATION_ENABLED defaults false until Worker and verified model profiles are available. Durable PG task; no fire-and-forget Worker request. Same normalized request/key returns the original snapshot and price, with replayed=true.
